description:
Markdown-based note-taking app for developers


4.9.2
Fixed
- Relative image paths now resolve against the note's folder. A ![](images/photo.png) was only looked up from the vault root, so every note in a subfolder showed a broken image — including the common "attachments next to the note" setup. Paths are now resolved from the note's own folder first, then the vault root, then the vault file index. Applies to the live preview, note transclusions, copy-as-HTML, and the PDF/HTML export (the last two were baking the same broken paths into exported files).
- Images of the vault were invisible in the tree. They are now listed under their folder with a thumbnail, and a click opens a viewer: dimensions, size, actual-size zoom, insert into the open note, copy the markdown link, open with the default app, reveal in the file manager. The attachments folder, previously hidden, shows up as attachment storage.
- Linked external folders showed no images, not even after a refresh: mounting and refreshing a linked folder never went through the vault scan. Mount, refresh, and scan now produce the same rows; unmounting or deleting a folder drops its images along with its notes.
